text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while gathering race materials
in the academy library――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait!
I want to see that magazine too~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: If I remember right, the race where the President broke away and won is in this one, right~?♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aww. I wish I could run
just like the President someday~...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right now, my style is all about bursting from the fourth corner, but...
You can never have too many weapons in your arsenal, right?
choice_data_list: It'd be so cool if you could do it all!
It'd be so cool if you could do it all!
You already have a plenty formidable weapon as it is.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You think so too, right?!
Ahaha. You and I are totally on the same wavelength~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It might be tough, but I'm gonna give it my all!
'Cause I wanna become just like the Prez!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Tokai Teio energetically dashed off.
...It seemed I managed to bring out her motivation.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Heh-heh, as expected of me♪
You've got an eye for quality too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right, first I'm gonna hone the weapons I already have!
